subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama streaming treat the provider request timeout as an idle/progress timeout once NDJSON chunks are arriving?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and matches sibling stream handling, but it changes an existing timeout semantic that operators may rely on as a total cap.

options.title: Require proof, then accept parity
options.body: Ask for redacted remote or slow Ollama proof, then allow the native stream to match sibling streaming transports by refreshing the guard timeout per chunk.

options.title: Keep wall-clock timeout
options.body: Reject this timeout semantic change and pursue a different fix for the stall that preserves timeoutSeconds as a total request cap.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then accept parity
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted remote or slow Ollama proof, then allow the native stream to match sibling streaming transports by refreshing the guard timeout per chunk.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this owner candidate to Ollama timeout and streaming behavior in the affected provider path.
